references.usedFor: Restored residential palace state, joined palace and galleries. Historical engraving is not a present-day survey.
Inspected ochre walls, pale pilasters, three-level window rhythm, central decorated risalit and pediment, barrel dormers and ceramic roofs.
Inspected grass-faced rampart, gatehouse, arched bridge, two differing metal crowns, low gallery roofs and entrance roof vents.
Six-sided palace courtyard, linked buildings and bastion enclosure. Wider World Heritage property includes the separate church and park, not bundled in this castle model.
Exact identity, placement frame and site geometry; independent palace parts and court saved in map-parts.json.

scope: Original procedural reconstruction. No third-party photographs or meshes bundled; no surveyed vertical datum or maximum-fidelity approval claimed.
